projectDescription: An archive of EB Client — an offline-capable, browser-based Eaglercraft (Minecraft) client powered by EaglercraftX and Wispcraft, which tunnels connections to Java Minecraft servers via the WISP protocol.
keyFeatures: Fully offline-capable single-file HTML distribution of Eaglercraft (Minecraft 1.8)
Wispcraft WISP-protocol tunneling to connect to Java Minecraft servers via WebSockets
Microsoft / Xbox Live account authentication with device-code OAuth flow
Multiple relay servers (lax1dude and ayunami relays) for Eaglercraft multiplayer
Versioned Nextgen releases (CU3 through CU7) plus self-hostable web file bundles
EaglercraftX runtime with WASM-backed game engine and EPW asset packaging
Settings UI for configuring WISP server URL and managing Microsoft accounts
Support for both Java server addresses (java://) and Eaglercraft relay addresses (wss://)
publicApiSurface: window.eaglercraftXOpts — configuration object (container, worldsDB, relays, servers)
eaglercraftXOpts.assetsURI — URL or data URI for the EPW asset bundle
eaglercraftXOpts.container — DOM element ID for the game canvas
window.setWispUrl(url) — override the active WISP server URL at runtime
window.showSettingsUI() — programmatically open the Wispcraft settings panel
window.getAuthCode() — retrieve the current Microsoft auth device code flow data
window.DEFAULT_WISP_URL — the default WISP relay endpoint
window.VERSION — current EB Client build version string
EpoxyClient — WebAssembly WISP transport client with connect_tcp, connect_tls, connect_udp, connect_websocket, fetch methods

EpoxyClientOptions — configuration for EpoxyClient (wisp_v2, udp_extension_required, title_case_headers, websocket_protocols, redirect_limit, header_limit, user_agent, pem_files, disable_certificate_validation, buffer_size)
Relay configuration: { addr, comment, primary } objects in eaglercraftXOpts.relays
